subject: IsiNdebele
topic: Uhlelo Lolimi — Izitho Zenkulumo (Parts of Speech)
content:
UHLELO LOLIMI: IZITHO ZENKULUMO — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Ukuze umfundi akwazi ukukhuluma lokubhala isiNdebele ngendlela efaneleyo, kumele aqedisise izitho zenkulumo ezakha umutsho. Isitho senkulumo yilona gatsha lolimi elitshengisa umsebenzi wegama emutshweni. Isikolo esiPhakemeyo saseZimbabwe (ZIMSEC) sifuna ukuthi abafundi bebanga lesi-7 bakwazi ukwehlukanisa, ukusebenzisa, kanye lokwakha imitsho elandela imithetho yohlelo yesiNdebele belusebenzisa lolu lwazi ekubhaleni lasekukhulumeni.

Izitho zenkulumo ezimqoka kusiNdebele yilezi ezilandelayo: IBIZO, ISABIZWANA, ISENZO, ISIPHAWULO, UPHAWULISANDISO, ISANDISO, UPHAWULOZIBOPHO (isibopho), ISIBALULI, kanye leSIBABAZO.

1. IBIZO (NOUN)
Ibizo ligama eliqamba into, umuntu, indawo, isikhathi, umcabango, kumbe isenzakalo. Amabizo esiNdebele ehlukaniswa ngezigaba (noun classes) ngokwesiqalo (prefix) esiwelekelela impande yebizo (root). Isibonelo: umuntu (umu-ntu), abantu (aba-ntu), umuzi (umu-zi), imizi (imi-zi), isitsha (isi-tsha), izitsha (izi-tsha), ilizwe (ili-zwe), amazwe (ama-zwe), isikole (isi-kole), izikole (izi-kole), ubuntu (ubu-ntu), ukudla (uku-dla).

Amabizo aphinda ehlukaniswe abe:
(a) Amabizo aqondileyo (proper nouns) — asho okukhethekileyo okulebizo elikhethekileyo, isibonelo: uMoyo, uSipho, iBulawayo, iZimbabwe, uMzilikazi.
(b) Amabizo ajwayelekileyo (common nouns) — asho izinto ngokubanzi, isibonelo: umuntu, indlu, isikolo, inkomo.
(c) Amabizo abuthelelweyo/aqoqiweyo (collective nouns) — asho iqoqo, isibonelo: umhlambi (weinkomo), isixuku (sabantu), inhlangano.
(d) Amabizo angabonakaliyo/omoya (abstract nouns) — asho umcabango kumbe imizwa engabambekiyo, isibonelo: uthando, intukuthelo, ukuthula, ubuqotho.

Uhlu Lwezigaba Zamabizo (Noun Class System):
Isigaba 1 (umu-/u-): umuntu, umfana, umama — abantu (isigaba 2: aba-)
Isigaba 3 (umu-): umuzi, umuthi — imizi, imithi (isigaba 4: imi-)
Isigaba 5 (ili-/i-): ilizwe, ihlobo — amazwe, amahlobo (isigaba 6: ama-)
Isigaba 7 (isi-): isitsha, isikole — izitsha, izikole (isigaba 8: izi-)
Isigaba 9 (in-/im-): inja, imbuzi — izinja, izimbuzi (isigaba 10: izin-/izim-)
Isigaba 11 (ulu-/u-): uluthi, udonga — izinti, izindonga
Isigaba 14 (ubu-): ubuhle, ubuntu (amabizo omoya, awela masotsha)
Isigaba 15 (uku-): ukudla, ukuhamba (izenzo ezisetshenziswa njengamabizo — infinitives)

Umqondisi kumele afundise abafundi ukuthi isiqalo sebizo siyaguquka nxa kusiya ebunengini (plural), njalo lokho kuthinta lezinye izitho ezihambelana lalelobizo emutshweni — isabizwana, isiphawulo, kanye lesenzo (concord/ukuvumelana).

2. ISABIZWANA (PRONOUN)
Isabizwana ligama elingena esikhundleni sebizo ukuze kungaphindwa igama linye njalonjalo emutshweni. Izinhlobo zezabizwana yilezi:
- Isabizwana somuntukhulumayo/senhloko (personal pronouns): mina, wena, yena, thina, lina, bona.
- Isabizwana sokukhomba (demonstrative pronouns): lo, lo, laba, lezi, lawa, njll — kuya ngesigaba sebizo elikhonjwayo.
- Isabizwana esiqubuliweyo (possessive pronoun stems): -ami, -akho, -akhe, -ethu, -enu, -abo (isib. umuzi wami, izindlu zethu).
- Isabizwana sombuzo (interrogative pronouns): ngubani? kuyini? yiphi? ngaki?
- Isabizwana esingelamngcele (indefinite pronouns): wonke, bonke, ngamunye.

Isibonelo emutshweni: "UThemba ufundile incwadi yakhe." Lapha "yakhe" ngumfanekiso wesabizwana esiqubuliweyo esimela uThemba.

3. ISENZO (VERB)
Isenzo yigama elitshengisa isenzakalo, isimo, kumbe ukuba khona kwento. Impande yesenzo ihlala igcina umqondo omkhulu wesenzo, kuthi izimaho (affixes) ezengezelelwe ngaphambili loba ngemva zitshintshe isikhathi, ubunengi, kumbe uhlobo. Isibonelo: -hamba (impande) — ngiyahamba, wahamba, sizahamba, bengihamba.

Izigaba zezenzo:
(a) Izenzo eziphelelisiweyo (transitive verbs) — zidinga into eyenziwayo (object): "Ngiyabona inkomo." (inkomo yinto eboniwayo)
(b) Izenzo ezingapheleliyo (intransitive verbs) — kazidingi nto eyenziwayo: "Umntwana uyalala."
(c) Izenzo ezizenzelayo (reflexive verbs) — umenzi wenzela yena ngokwakhe, kusetshenziswa isibopho "-zi-": ukuzigeza, ukuzifundisa, ukuzibona.
(d) Izenzo eziphathekayo (auxiliary verbs) — zisiza ezinye izenzo ukwakha izikhathi kumbe imimoya, isibonelo: -ya-, -nga-, -be-.

4. ISIPHAWULO (ADJECTIVE / QUALIFICATIVE)
Isiphawulo yigama elichaza ibizo, lisenza sazi umumo, ibala, ubukhulu, kumbe isimo salelobizo. Isiphawulo esiNdebele kumele sivumelane lesigaba sebizo esilandelayo. Isibonelo: umuntu omkhulu, abantu abakhulu, isitsha esikhulu, izitsha ezinkulu, ilizwe elikhulu, amazwe amakhulu — nanzelela ukuguquka kwesiqalisi "om-, aba-, esi-, ezin-, eli-, ama-" ukulandela isigaba sebizo.

Amabala nezimo eziqhubekayo kusetshenziswa: -hle (kuhle), -bi (kubi), -khulu (kukhulu), -ncane (kuncane), -de (kude), -fitshane (kufitshane).

5. UPHAWULISANDISO (ADVERB)
Luchaza isenzo, isiphawulo, kumbe olunye uphawulisandiso — lutshengisa indlela, isikhathi, indawo, kumbe isilinganiso. Isibonelo: ngesiquphe (indlela), namhlanje (isikhathi), lapha (indawo), kakhulu (isilinganiso).

6. ISANDISO (COPULATIVE / IDENTIFIER)
Isandiso sitshengisa ukuthi into ithini kumbe ingubani, sisebenza njengokuhlobanisa amagama amabili. Isibonelo: "Lo ngumfundi." "Laba ngabafundi." "UMoyo nguthisha."

7. UPHAWULOZIBOPHO (CONJUNCTION)
Amagama ahlanganisa amabinzana kumbe imitsho: kodwa, njalo, kumbe, ngoba, ngakho, nxa, lapho.

8. ISIBALULI (PREPOSITION-LIKE PARTICLES) leZIBOPHO
IsiNdebele asilazibopho ezizimeleyo ezinjengesiNgisi "in, on, at" ngendlela efanayo; endaweni yalokho kusetshenziswa izengezo ebizweni njengalezi: e-, ku-, nga-, la- — isibonelo: esikolo, kubantwana, ngesikhathi, lomntwana.

9. ISIBABAZO (INTERJECTION)
Igama elitshengisa umzwelo ngokujahileyo: Hawu! Yeyi! Awu! Maye! Yebo! Hatshi!

UKUSEBENZISWA KWEMITHETHO YOKUVUMELANA (CONCORD)
Umthetho omkhulu wohlelo lwesiNdebele yikuvumelana kwezitho zenkulumo lesigaba sebizo elilandelwayo. Konke — isabizwana, isiphawulo, isenzo (ngokwesivumelwano somenzi) — kumele kuvumelane lebizo. Lokhu yikho okwenza isiNdebele sibe lolimi olulesakhiwo esicacileyo njalo esilomthetho oqinileyo.

IZIBONELO ZOKUHLAZIYA UMUTSHO
"Abafana abakhulu balamile inkomo ezinhle kakhulu ezizeni yabo endala."
- Abafana = ibizo (isigaba 2, ubunengi)
- abakhulu = isiphawulo esivumelana lebizo
- balamile = isenzo (sivumelana lomenzi ngobunengi)
- inkomo = ibizo (into eyenziwayo)
- ezinhle = isiphawulo
- kakhulu = uphawulisandiso
- ezizeni yabo endala = ibinzana lendawo elilesandiso lesiphawulo

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Abafundi kabakhe imitsho eyisikhombisa besebenzisa itshu ngalinye lezitho zenkulumo ezingaphezulu, bahlukanise umutsho ngamunye batshengise isigaba sebizo lokuvumelana kwazo zonke izitho.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
content:
UHLELO LOLIMI: IZIKHATHI ZESENZO — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Isikhathi sesenzo (tense) sitshengisa ukuthi isenzakalo senzeka nini — endulo, khathesi, kumbe ngokuzayo. IsiNdebele silezinhlobo ezinengi zezikhathi ezenza umkhulumi akwazi ukutsho ngokuqondileyo ukuthi into yenzakala nini langayiphi indlela. Impande yesenzo ihlala imi njengoba injalo, kuthi izimaho ezengezelelweyo ngaphambili langemuva zenze umqondo wesikhathi.

1. ISIKHATHI SAKHATHESI (PRESENT TENSE)
(a) Okwenzakala khathesi okuqhubekayo: isakhiwo — ngi-ya-hamba, u-ya-hamba, si-ya-hamba, ba-ya-hamba.
Isibonelo: "Ngiyahamba esikolo khathesi." "Umama uyapheka ekhitshini."
(b) Okwenzeka njalonjalo (habitual present): kususwa u-ya- kusale isimaho njengoba injalo — "Ngihamba esikolo insuku zonke." "Abantwana bafunda ibanga lesi-7."

2. ISIKHATHI ESEDLULE (PAST TENSE)
(a) Okwenzakele kudlule khonokho (recent past / immediate past): isimaho -e ekucineni — "Ngahamba." "Wafika." "Sadla ukudla."
(b) Okwenzakele endulo (remote/far past — with -a- and often "be-" auxiliary): "Bengihamba lapho izolo." "Sasidlala emini."
(c) Okuphelele okwenzakeleyo (perfect tense — okusasho umphumela okhona khathesi): isimaho -ile — "Ngifikile." "Sesidlile." "Bahambile."

Kumqoka ukuthi umfundi ehlukanise phakathi kwe "ngahamba" (kwenzakele kwaphela) le "ngifikile" (kwenzakele njalo umphumela usekhona khathesi).

3. ISIKHATHI ESIZAYO (FUTURE TENSE)
(a) Okuzokwenzeka masinyane (immediate future): -za- — "Ngizahamba khathesi." "Sizadla manje."
(b) Okuzokwenzeka kwesinye isikhathi (distant future): kungasetshenziswa amabinzana esikhathi kanye lesimaho -za- — "Sizafunda kusasa." "Bazabuya ngeviki elizayo."

4. UMOYA WOKUPHIKA (NEGATIVE FORM)
Ukuphika kwenziwa ngokusebenzisa isiqalo "ka-" phambi komenzi kanye lokuguqula isigcino sesenzo kusiya ku "-i" endaweni ka "-a": "Ngiyahamba" kuba "Kangihambi." "Wafika" kuba "Kafikanga." "Ngizahamba" kuba "Kangizukuhamba/Kangiyikuhamba."

Uhlu Lwemizekelo Yokuphika Ngezikhathi Ezehlukeneyo:
- Khathesi: Ngiyafunda — Kangifundi
- Okwedlule (khonokho): Ngafunda — Kangifundanga
- Okuphelele: Ngifundile — Kangikafundi
- Okuzayo: Ngizafunda — Kangizukufunda / Kangiyikufunda

5. IMIMOYA YESENZO (MOODS)
(a) Umoya wesiqondiso (indicative mood) — utsho iqiniso: "Uyahamba."
(b) Umoya wesilayo (imperative mood) — ulaya kumbe uyacela: "Hamba!" "Wozani lapha!" "Dlana kuhle."
(c) Umoya wesibopho/wesimiselo (subjunctive mood) — utsho injongo kumbe isifiso: "Ngifuna ukuthi uhambe." "Kumele afunde."
(d) Umoya wongabaza (potential mood) — utsho ukuthi kungenzakala: "Angahamba nxa efuna."

6. IZENZO EZIPHATHEKAYO KANYE LEMISEBENZI YAZO
Izenzo eziphathekayo ezifana lo "-be-", "-sa-", "-nga-" ziyasiza ukwakha izikhathi ezixubeneyo:
- "Bengisahamba" (Ngangisahamba) — I was still going.
- "Ngangisafunda mhla lowo." — I was still studying that day.
- "Ngangisazakwenza lokho." — I was still going to do that.

7. UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Nikeza abafundi impande yesenzo "-bhala" (ukubhala) bakhe imitsho elandelayo besebenzisa zonke izikhathi ezifundiweyo: khathesi okuqhubekayo, okwedlule khonokho, okuphelele, kanye lokuzayo, kokubili ngendlela evumayo lengephikiyo. Lokhu kusiza umfundi aqiniseke ukuthi uyakwazi ukuguqula isakhiwo sesenzo ngokwesikhathi lomoya ngendlela efaneleyo, okuyikho okuhlolwa kakhulu kwiPhepha 2 leZIMSEC.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
topic: Uhlelo Lolimi — Izigaba Zamabizo Kanye Lokuvumelana (Noun Classes & Concord)
content:
UHLELO LOLIMI: IZIGABA ZAMABIZO KANYE LOKUVUMELANA — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Isakhiwo sohlelo lwesiNdebele simi ngezigaba zamabizo (noun classes). Isigaba ngasinye silesiqalo esikhethekileyo esitshengisa ubunye (singular) kumbe ubunengi (plural), njalo lesosiqalo sibanga ukuguquka kwazo zonke izitho ezihambelana lalelobizo emutshweni — lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi yikuvumelana (concord).

UHLU OLUPHELELEYO LWEZIGABA
Isigaba 1: umu- / u- (umuntu, umfana) — Ubunye
Isigaba 2: aba- / o- (abantu, abafana; oMoyo — abantu abaqanjwe ngamabizo aqondileyo) — Ubunengi besigaba 1
Isigaba 1a: u- (kubizo lomuntu oqanjwe: uSipho, ubaba)
Isigaba 2a: bo- (oSipho, obaba)
Isigaba 3: umu- (umuzi, umuthi, umlenze) — Ubunye
Isigaba 4: imi- (imizi, imithi, imilenze) — Ubunengi besigaba 3
Isigaba 5: ili- / i- (ilizwe, itshe, iqanda) — Ubunye
Isigaba 6: ama- (amazwe, amatshe, amaqanda) — Ubunengi besigaba 5
Isigaba 7: isi- (isitsha, isihlalo, isikole) — Ubunye
Isigaba 8: izi- (izitsha, izihlalo, izikole) — Ubunengi besigaba 7
Isigaba 9: in- / im- (inja, imbuzi, indlu) — Ubunye
Isigaba 10: izin- / izim- (izinja, izimbuzi, izindlu) — Ubunengi besigaba 9
Isigaba 11: ulu- / u- (uluthi, udonga, ulimi) — Ubunye (ubunengi bufakwa ngaphansi kwesigaba 10: izinti, izindonga, izilimi)
Isigaba 14: ubu- (ubuhle, ubuntu, ubusuku) — Amabizo omoya, awela masotsha, kawelamnengi
Isigaba 15: uku- (ukudla, ukuhamba, ukufunda) — Izenzo ezisetshenziswa njengamabizo (infinitive)
Isigaba 16-18 (izigaba zendawo/locative): pha-, ku-, e- (phansi, kubantu, emzini)

IMITHETHO YOKUVUMELANA (CONCORD RULES)
Isigaba sebizo sitshengisa isivumelwano esisetshenziswa kuzozonke izitho zenkulumo ezihambelana lalelobizo:

Isigaba 1/2 (abantu):
- Isiphawulo: umuntu omuhle — abantu abahle
- Isabizwana sokukhomba: lo muntu — laba bantu
- Isenzo: umuntu uyahamba — abantu bayahamba

Isigaba 7/8 (izinto ezizimeleyo):
- Isiphawulo: isitsha esihle — izitsha ezinhle
- Isabizwana: lesi sitsha — lezi zitsha
- Isenzo: isitsha siyaphuka — izitsha ziyaphuka

Isigaba 9/10 (izilwane/izinto):
- Isiphawulo: inja enhle — izinja ezinhle
- Isabizwana: le nja — lezi zinja
- Isenzo: inja iyakhonkotha — izinja ziyakhonkotha

Isigaba 5/6:
- Isiphawulo: ilizwe elikhulu — amazwe amakhulu
- Isabizwana: leli lizwe — la mazwe
- Isenzo: ilizwe liyabusa — amazwe ayabusa

ISIBONELO ESIPHELELEYO SOKUHLAZIYA
"Izitsha ezinhle lezi zaphukile ngoba abantwana abancane babengaziqaphelanga."
- Izitsha (isigaba 8, ubunengi)
- ezinhle (isiphawulo esivumelana lesigaba 8)
- lezi (isabizwana sokukhomba, isigaba 8)
- zaphukile (isenzo esivumelana lesigaba 8, isikhathi esiphelele)
- abantwana (isigaba 2)
- abancane (isiphawulo esivumelana lesigaba 2)
- babengaziqaphelanga (isenzo esivumelana lesigaba 2, esiphikiweyo, esedlule)

IMPAWU EZIBALULEKILEYO KUBAFUNDI
1. Isigaba sebizo yiso esimisa yonke eminye imithetho yomutsho — akula "umthetho ohlukene" wesabizwana loba wesiphawulo ngaphandle kwesigaba.
2. Amabizo amanengi asuselwa kwelinye ibizo kumbe kwesinye isitho senkulumo ngokusebenzisa izengezo (isib. umfundisi kusukela ku "-fundisa", isihlalo kusukela ku "-hlala").
3. Amabizo abunye lawesigaba 14 (ubu-) lawesigaba 15 (uku-) awananzi ubunengi ngendlela ejwayelekileyo.

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Nikeza abafundi uhlu lwamabizo alitshumi ahlukeneyo, babhale isigaba sebizo ngasinye, bakhe umutsho ngalinye batshengise ukuvumelana kwesiphawulo, isabizwana, kanye lesenzo.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
topic: Ulimi Lomdabu — Izaga Lezitsho (Proverbs and Idioms)
content:
ULIMI LOMDABU: IZAGA LEZITSHO — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Izaga lezitsho yingxenye eqakathekileyo yolimi lwesiNdebele njalo kuhlolwa njalo kuPhepha 2 leZIMSEC. Izaga (proverbs) ngamazwi amfitshane alengqondo enzulu, ahlala equka isifundo sokuziphatha kumbe ukuhlakanipha kwabadala. Izitsho (idioms/figures of speech) yimitsho leyo okungamele ithathwe ngomqondo wayo oqondileyo kodwa ilomqondo ofihlakeleyo. Ukwazi ukusebenzisa lokuchaza izaga lezitsho kutshengisa ukuqonda kwabafundi ulimi ngokujulileyo.

UMEHLUKO PHAKATHI KWESAGA LESITSHO
Isaga (proverb) sihlala simi sodwa njengomutsho opheleleyo osifundo esizimeleyo, kanti isitsho (idiom) sisetshenziswa NGAPHAKATHI komutsho njengengxenye yomutsho lowo ukwengeza umqondo.

UHLU LWEZAGA EZIQAKATHEKILEYO LEZINCAZELO ZAZO

1. "Isandla sihlambana ngesinye." — Abantu bafanele ukusizana; umuntu oyedwa akulula ukuthi enze konke yedwa.
2. "Injobo ithungelwa ebandla." — Amacebo la izinqumo eziqakathekileyo kumele zithathwe ngokuxoxisana lomphakathi wonke.
3. "Ingwe idla ngamabala." — Ubuhlakani lokucabanga kuqakathekile ukwedlula amandla omzimba.
4. "Umuntu ngumuntu ngabantu." — Umuntu uba ngumuntu ngempela ngoba lomunye umuntu — ubuntu bugcweliswa yikuphathana kwabantu.
5. "Okuncane kayikhulu kungelutshalo." — Into encane ingakhula ibe nkulu nxa iphathwa kuhle.
6. "Inkukhu ithanda ichitha uju kuwo umlomo wayo." — Umuntu kwesinye isikhathi uzichithela okuhle kaziqondi.
7. "Amazwi obala kawadaleli ihlazo." — Ukukhuluma iqiniso kakubi bulala, liyaphephisa.
8. "Ihlo lomuntu kalikhathali." — Umuntu uyahlala esafuna okuthile, engamela lokho alakho.
9. "Umsebenzi ngumuntu." — Umuntu waziwa ngomsebenzi kumbe izenzo zakhe, hatshi ngamazwi.
10. "Isisila senyathi kasidluli inyathi." — Umntwana kumele ahloniphe abadala njalo angadlali ngamandla akhe.
11. "Uzakubona ngamanzi abuhlungu." — Uzakubona ubunzima nxa usenza into engalunganga.
12. "Akulahlwa mwana ngokufa." — Loba into embi yenzakele, kakumele kulahlwe ithemba loba isibopho.
13. "Insini yenja ayifiki emafini." — Kuqakathekile ukuhlonipha izikhathi lezindawo ezehlukeneyo.
14. "Imvubu yakhula esiziba." — Umuntu ukhula endaweni afanele ikhaya lakhe.

UHLU LWEZITSHO EZIQAKATHEKILEYO LEZINCAZELO ZAZO

1. "Ukudla umhlanganiso" — Ukubulawa/ukufa.
2. "Ukuhlaba ikhwelo" — Ukumemeza ukuthi kulengozi kumbe uxwayiso.
3. "Ukungena endlebeni" — Ukuzwakala/ukuqondwa kuhle.
4. "Ukuphosa amanzi emlonyeni" — Ukuthula ngokuzikhethela, ukungakhulumi.
5. "Ukudla inhliziyo" — Ukukhathazeka kakhulu.
6. "Ukuvala amehlo" — Ukuzitshiyela into engaqondananga, ukungananzeleli.
7. "Ukuba lezandla ezimhlophe" — Ukuba ngongelacala.
8. "Ukubhoboza amehlo" — Ukukhomba iqiniso ngokusobala.
9. "Ukudlula lengane emanzini" — Ukwenza into engelalusizo.
10. "Ukukhipha inhliziyo" — Ukuzikhipha imizwa yobuhlungu ngokukhuluma.

INDLELA YOKUFUNDISA/UKUSEBENZISA IZAGA LEZITSHO EMPENDULWENI ZOKUHLOLWA
Nxa umbuzo ucela ukuchaza isaga kumbe isitsho, umfundi kumele:
(a) Achaze umqondo ofihlakeleyo (hatshi owamazwi ngamunye), (b) Anike isibonelo sokuthi singasetshenziswa nini emphakathini, (c) Asebenzise ulimi olucacileyo lolulungileyo lwesiNdebele.

Isibonelo Sempendulo Egculisayo:
Umbuzo: "Chaza ngamazwi akho okutshiwo yisaga esithi: 'Isandla sihlambana ngesinye.'"
Impendulo: "Isaga lesi sitshengisa ukuthi kakho umuntu ongaphila yedwa emhlabeni; siyadingana ukuze sisizane emisebenzini yansuku zonke. Isibonelo, nxa umuntu esakha indlu, angeke akwazi ukwenza wonke umsebenzi yedwa — kumele asizwe ngabanye ukuze umsebenzi uphele masinyane njalo kuhle."

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Nikeza abafundi izaga ezinhlanu ezitsha, babhale incazelo yazo ngamazwi abo, banike lesibonelo sendlela ezingasetshenziswa ngayo endabeni.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
content:
ULIMI LOMDABU: INGANEKWANE — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Inganekwane yindaba yendabuko eyayilandiswa ebusuku ngabadala kubantwana ukufundisa izifundo zokuziphatha, ukuhlakanipha, kanye lamasiko esintu. Inganekwane zihlala ziqukatha izilwane ezikhulumayo, amakhosi, kumbe izidalwa ezingaphandle kwemvelo ejwayelekileyo. Ibanga 7 lifundiswa ukwazi isakhiwo senganekwane, ukwehlula izinhlobo zayo, kanye lokubhala inganekwane yakhe ngokwakhe.

ISAKHIWO SENGANEKWANE (STRUCTURE OF A FOLKTALE)
1. Isingeniso — Kwakukhona (once upon a time), kwaziswa indawo kanye labalingiswa.
2. Umzimba wendaba — Kuvela inkinga (conflict/problem), kuqhubeke izigigaba (events) ezilandelanayo ngendlela ehlelekileyo.
3. Isiphetho — Inkinga iyaxazululwa, kuvela isifundo (moral lesson) esicace bha ekucineni kwendaba.

IMVAMA YOKUQALISA LOKUPHETHA INGANEKWANE
Ukuqalisa: "Kwasukasukela..." Abalaleli baphendula: "Cosi!" Umlandisi uyaqhubeka: "Kwakukhona..."
Ukuphetha: "Yaze yaphela indaba." kumbe "Kwaze kwaba yikho lokho."

IZINHLOBO ZENGANEKWANE
(a) Inganekwane zezilwane (animal tales) — kubandakanya izilwane ezikhulumayo njengomvundla, impisi, ingwe, njll., ezihlakaniphileyo kumbe eziyizithutha. Isibonelo esaziwayo: "UMvundla LeMpisi" — apho umvundla ohlakaniphileyo ehlula impisi enkulu ngobuhlakani hatshi ngamandla.
(b) Inganekwane zamakhosi (tales of kings/heroes) — kukhulunywa ngamakhosi, amaqhawe, kumbe izindaba zombuso.
(c) Inganekwane ezilezimanga (tales of the supernatural) — kubandakanya abathakathi, izidalwa ezingajwayelekanga, kumbe imimoya.
(d) Inganekwane zokufundisa (didactic/moral tales) — inhloso yazo yikufundisa ngokwehlukana kobuhle lobubi.

ISIBONELO ESIPHELELEYO SENGANEKWANE: "UMVUNDLA LENGWE"
Kwasukasukela, kwakukhona ingwe eyayihlala isiba yisidlakela emzini wezilwane. Yayihlala isongela ukudla izilwane ezincane. Ngelinye ilanga yathi izadla umvundla. Umvundla wathi ehlakaniphile, wacela ingwe ukuthi kuqale kubonwe ukuthi ngubani oleliso elikhulu phakathi kwabo bobabili phambi kokuthi kudliwe. Wathi kayibukele emanzini omfula ukuze babone imifanekiso yabo. Ingwe yathi ilokhu ikhangele emanzini, umvundla wayiphosa emfuleni waze wagijima wabalekela ekhaya lakhe evikele. Kusukela lapho, izilwane zafunda ukuthi ubuhlakani bungehlula amandla.
Isifundo: Ubuhlakani buqakathekile kulamandla omzimba; ukucabanga ngokujulileyo kungakusiza ekuhluleni izinkinga ezinkulu.

INDLELA YOKUBHALA INGANEKWANE (COMPOSITION SKILL)
Nxa umfundi ecelwa ukubhala inganekwane kuPhepha 2, kumele alandele isakhiwo lesi:
1. Aqalise ngebinzana elijwayelekileyo ("Kwasukasukela...").
2. Achaze abalingiswa kanye lendawo ngamafitshane.
3. Akhe inkinga ecacileyo eqinileyo, aqhubekise izigigaba ezintathu kumbe ezine ngokulandelana okuhle.
4. Aphethe ngesixazululo esicacileyo kanye lesifundo esiqondakalayo.
5. Asebenzise ulimi oluhlobene lendaba yendabuko — amagama afana lo "kwathi-ke", "kusenjalo", "ngakusasa".

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Cela abafundi ukuthi babhale inganekwane yabo emfitshane (imitsho engu 15-20) ilesifundo esicacileyo, besebenzisa isakhiwo esifundisiweyo ngenhla.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
content:
ULIMI LOMDABU: IZINKONDLO — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Isinkondlo yindlela yokuloba amazwi ngobuciko okwenza umuzwa kumbe umcabango uzwakale ngamandla kulokukhuluma okujwayelekileyo. Ibanga 7 lifundiswa ukubona izici zesinkondlo, ukuchaza umqondo kanye lomzwelo osindlweni, kanye lokuhlela isinkondlo saso ngokwakhe.

IZICI ZESINKONDLO (FEATURES OF POETRY)
1. Isigaba/Ivesi (Stanza) — iqoqo lemitsho esinkondlweni.
2. Umgqa (Line) — umutsho ngamunye ngaphakathi kwesigaba.
3. Isigqi (Rhythm) — indlela amazwi alandelana ngayo aveze umculo lapho sifundwa ngamazwi.
4. Ukuphindwa (Repetition) — ukuphinda igama kumbe ibinzana ukugcizelela umqondo.
5. Umfanekiso ngamazwi (Imagery) — amazwi akha isithombe engqondweni yomfundi, isibonelo "ilanga lakhanya njengegolide."
6. Isingathekiso (Simile) — ukufananisa izinto ezimbili kusetshenziswa "njenga-" kumbe "kunjengo-": "Uhlakaniphe njengengwe."
7. Isingathekiso esifihlakeleyo (Metaphor) — ukufananisa okungasebenzisi "njenga-": "Ulilanga lami."
8. Ukuphathisa (Personification) — ukunika izinto ezingaphiliyo izimo zabantu: "Umoya wawuhleka phezu kwezihlahla."
9. Ukuphindaphinda konkulumo (Alliteration) — amagama aqalisa ngonkulumo ofananayo alandelana.

IZINHLOBO ZEZINKONDLO
(a) Izinkondlo zendabuko (traditional/oral poetry) — izangelo, izibongo zamakhosi, imilolozelo (lullabies), amaculo enhlonipho.
(b) Izinkondlo zesimanje (modern written poetry) — ezibhalwe ngababhali ngesikhathi samanje, zihlela izihloko ezifana lemvelo, uthando, ukuzikhandla, kanye lombuso.
(c) Izibongo (praise poetry) — inhlobo eqakathekileyo yamasiko esiNdebele, ezibonga amakhosi, abantu, kumbe izinto ezinjengomlambo loba intaba ngamazwi acikizekileyo.

ISIBONELO SESINKONDLO ESIFITSHANE
"UMVELINQANGI"
Ilanga liyaphuma emphandeni wempumalanga,
Litshisa umhlaba ngothando olungapheliyo.
Izinyoni ziyahlabelela ngenjabulo yempilo,
Imithi iyagobhoza ngamandla omhlaba.

Nkosi ehlakaniphileyo, wena owadala konke,
Siyabonga ngempilo osinike yona.

Ukuhlaziya: Isinkondlo lesi sisebenzisa ukuphathisa ("Ilanga liyaphuma... litshisa"), umfanekiso ngamazwi (ilanga, izinyoni, imithi), kanye lomzwelo wokubonga (gratitude). Isihloko yikubonga uMdali ngemvelo.

INDLELA YOKUHLAZIYA ISINKONDLO KUHLOLWA
Nxa umbuzo ucela ukuhlaziya isinkondlo, umfundi kumele:
1. Achaze isihloko esikhulu sesinkondlo (main theme).
2. Akhombe izici zolimi ezisetshenzisiweyo (isingathekiso, ukuphathisa, njll.) kanye lomsebenzi wazo.
3. Achaze umzwelo (mood/tone) osindlweni — injabulo, usizi, ukukhathazeka, njll.
4. Anike umbono wakhe mayelana lomlayezo wesinkondlo.

INDLELA YOKUBHALA ISINKONDLO SAKHO
1. Khetha isihloko esilomqondo kuwe — imvelo, ikhaya, uthando lwabazali, njll.
2. Sebenzisa amagama alomfanekiso ocacileyo, gwema ukuloba njengendaba ejwayelekileyo.
3. Hlela imigqa ibe yizigaba (stanzas) ezilesigqi.
4. Sebenzisa okungenani icebo linye lolimi (isingathekiso kumbe ukuphathisa) ukwenza isinkondlo sibe ngcono.

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Nikeza abafundi isihloko esithi "Ikhaya Lami" babhale isinkondlo esilezigaba ezimbili kusiya kwezintathu, basebenzise okungenani izici ezimbili zolimi ezifundisiweyo.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
topic: Ukubhala — Izindaba, Izincwadi Lemibhalo Eyehlukeneyo (Composition Writing)
content:
UKUBHALA: IZINDABA, IZINCWADI LEMIBHALO EYEHLUKENEYO — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Ekuhlolweni kwePhepha 2 leZIMSEC, abafundi bebanga 7 bacelwa ukubhala imibhalo eyehlukeneyo — indaba (narrative), incwadi (letter), umbhalo ochazayo (descriptive), kanye lesifinyezo (summary). Isahluko lesi sichaza indlela yokubhala umbhalo ngamunye ngendlela egculisayo.

1. INDABA (NARRATIVE COMPOSITION)
Indaba ilandisa izigigaba ezilandelanayo ngesikhathi. Isakhiwo:
- Isingeniso: Chaza indawo, isikhathi, kanye labalingiswa.
- Umzimba: Landisa izigigaba ngokulandelana kwesikhathi (chronological order), sebenzisa amabinzana afana lo "kwathi ekuseni", "ngemva kwesikhatshana", "kusenjalo".
- Isiphetho: Vala indaba ngesiphetho esicacileyo — kungaba yisifundo, umuzwa, kumbe umphumela wesigigaba.

Isibonelo Sesihloko: "Usuku Engingasoze Ngilukhohlwe" — Umfundi angalandisa ngosuku aluthile olwenzakala kuye, njengokulahleka, umonakalo, kumbe umnyaka wempumelelo.

2. INCWADI (LETTER WRITING)
IsiNdebele sifundisa izinhlobo ezimbili zencwadi:
(a) Incwadi yosekwane/yobungane (informal/friendly letter) — ibhalelwa umuntu owaziwayo njengomngane loba isihlobo. Isakhiwo: Ikheli lomlobi (kwesokudla phezulu), usuku, isibingelelo esilobungane ("Mngane wami othandekayo," / "Sisi othandekayo,"), umzimba wencwadi ochazwa ngokungananzelelwa, isivalelo esilothando ("Ngiyakuthanda," / "Ohlala engumngane wakho,"), kanye lesiginesha.
(b) Incwadi esemthethweni (formal letter) — ibhalelwa umuntu ongaziwayo kumbe olesikhundla, njengothisha, umphathi, kumbe inhlangano. Isakhiwo: Ikheli lomlobi, usuku, ikheli lomamukeli, isibingelelo esisemthethweni ("Mnumzana othandekayo," / "Nkosikazi othandekayo,"), isihloko esicacileyo, umzimba ohlelwe ngezigatshana, isivalelo esisemthethweni ("Ngiyabonga," / "Ngilotshiwe nguwe othembekileyo,"), leSiginesha.

Amazwi Aqakathekileyo Encwadini Esemthethweni: "Ngilotsha incwadi le ngenjongo yokucela...", "Ngiyacela ukuthi lingicabangele isicelo sami...", "Ngilindele impendulo yenu ngokuzithoba."

3. UMBHALO OCHAZAYO (DESCRIPTIVE COMPOSITION)
Uchaza indawo, umuntu, kumbe into ngendlela ecacileyo esebenzisa yonke imizwa emihlanu (ukubona, ukuzwa, ukuhogela, ukunambitha, ukuthinta). Isibonelo Sesihloko: "Ikhaya Lami" — chaza indlu, isiqinti, imvelo eyakhelene lekhaya, kanye lomuzwa owakho lapho ukhona.

4. ISIFINYEZO (SUMMARY WRITING)
Kwelinye iphepha, abafundi bacelwa ukufinyeza indima abayifundileyo babeke imibono emikhulu kuphela, bagweme ukuphinda amazwi afana lawaphepheni langesu, basebenzise amazwi abo ngokwabo lapho kusenzeka, bagcine ilinganiso lamagama elicelwayo (isib. amagama angadluli angu-80).

IMIHLAHLANDLELA EJWAYELEKILEYO YOKUBHALA
1. Bala umbuzo kuhle uqonde ukuthi ucela muphi umbhalo (indaba, incwadi, njll.).
2. Hlela imicabango yakho phambi kokubhala — bhala amaphuzu amakhulu ngamafitshane.
3. Sebenzisa ulimi olulungileyo lwesiNdebele — gwema ukuxuba isiNgisi lesiNdebele (code-switching).
4. Hlola ubude bombhalo obucelwayo (word count) ungadluli loba ungafinyeleli.
5. Ekucineni, phequlula umbhalo wakho uhlole amaphutha ohlelo kanye lokupela.

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Cela abafundi babhale incwadi esemthethweni eya kuMqondisi weSikolo becela imvumo yokwenza umcimbi wesikolo, basebenzise isakhiwo esifundisiweyo ngenhla ngokugcweleyo.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
content:
UKUBALA NGOKUZWISISA — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Ukubala ngokuzwisisa yikho ukubala umbhalo bese uqonda umqondo wawo ngokugcweleyo, ukwazi ukuphendula imibuzo ngokusekela impendulo endimeni. Iphepha 2 leZIMSEC lilendima yokubala okuqukatha imibuzo eyehlukeneyo — eminye ecela ukuphendula ngokusuka endimeni, eminye icela umbono womfundi.

AMACEBO OKUBALA NGOKUZWISISA
1. Bala indima yonke kuqala ungakabhali mpendulo, uqonde isihloko esikhulu.
2. Bala imibuzo yonke phambi kokuphendula ukuze wazi yikuphi okumele ukukhangele endimeni.
3. Bala indima kabili, kabili — ukubala kokuqala kungakunika umfanekiso obanzi, ukubala kwesibili ukuze ukhangele imininingwane eqondene lemibuzo.
4. Nxa umbuzo ucela "ngamazwi akho" (in your own words), kumele ungaphindi amazwi asendimeni ngqo, kodwa uwaguqule uwenze abe ngawakho ngokuzwisisa umqondo.
5. Nxa umbuzo ucela ukubala ivesi ethile, phendula ngokusekela endimeni leyo ngqo, ungachasisi kakhulu ngaphandle kwalokho okuceliweyo.
6. Hlolisisa amagama angaziwayo ngokusebenzisa umongo (context) wendima — akumelanga uyekele umbuzo ungaphenduliwe ngoba ungalazi igama elilodwa.

IZINHLOBO ZEMIBUZO EJWAYELEKILEYO
(a) Imibuzo yamaqiniso avelele (factual/direct questions) — impendulo itholakala ngqo endimeni.
(b) Imibuzo yokuzwisisa okujulileyo (inferential questions) — impendulo idinga ukucabanga ngokusekelwe kulokho okubhaliweyo, hatshi okuvela ngqo.
(c) Imibuzo yamagama (vocabulary questions) — kucelwa incazelo yamagama athile njengoba asetshenziswe endimeni.
(d) Imibuzo yombono (opinion questions) — kucelwa umbono womfundi ngesihloko sendima, kodwa impendulo kumele isekelwe ngokusekelwe endimeni.

ISIBONELO SENDIMA EFITSHANE LEMIBUZO
INDIMA: "USakhile wayehlala emzini omncane lomndeni wakhe eGwanda. Insuku zonke wayehamba amakhilomitha amathathu ukuya esikolo ngoba wayefuna ukufunda kakhulu ukuze abe ngudokotela nxa esekhulile. Loba kunzima, wayengalisi isikolo, njalo wayehlala engowokuqala ekilasini lakhe. Othisha bakhe babemthanda kakhulu ngenxa yokuzimisela kwakhe."

Imibuzo:
1. USakhile wayehlala kuphi? (Impendulo ngqo: eGwanda)
2. Wayehamba ibanga elingakanani ukuya esikolo? (Impendulo ngqo: amakhilomitha amathathu)
3. Kungani uSakhile wayezimisele kangaka esikolo? (Impendulo yokuzwisisa: Wayefuna ukuba ngudokotela, ngakho wayebona ukuthi imfundo iyindlela yokufeza leyo njongo.)
4. Ngamazwi akho, chaza ukuthi uSakhile wayengumuntu onjani. (Impendulo yombono/yokuzwisisa: uSakhile wayengumuntu ozimisele, olesibindi, njalo ofuna impumelelo empilweni yakhe.)

AMACEBO OKUZIQEQETSHA
Abafundi kumele bafunde ukubala izindima ezitsha ezitshiyeneyo insuku zonke ukuze bakhulise isivinini sokubala kanye lokuzwisisa. Kufanele bakhulise lolimi lwabo (vocabulary) ngokubala izincwadi zesiNdebele ezehlukeneyo, amaphephandaba, kanye lezinye izinsizakufunda.

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Nikeza abafundi indima entsha abangayifundanga, babhale imibuzo emihlanu ehlukeneyo ngezinhlobo ezehlukeneyo (eqondileyo, eyokuzwisisa, eyamagama, kanye leyombono) njalo baphendule bebodwa ukuze baziqeqetshe.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
content:
UKUQONDISISA LANGOKUKHULUMA — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
Ukuqondisisa ngokuzwa (listening) lokukhuluma (speaking) yizakhono eziqakathekileyo ekufundeni ulimi. Loba ukuhlolwa okunengi kugxile ekubhaleni, izakhono lezi ziyaqiniswa emakilasini ukuze abafundi bakhone ukuxhumana ngokukhululeka lomphakathi wabo besebenzisa isiNdebele esihle.

IZAKHONO ZOKUQONDISISA NGOKUZWA
1. Ukulalela ngokunanzelela indaba, ingxoxo, kumbe umlayezo ukhulunywayo.
2. Ukukwazi ukuphawula amaphuzu amakhulu emlayezweni owuzwileyo.
3. Ukuphendula imibuzo esekelwe kulokho okuzwiweyo, hatshi okubaliweyo.
4. Ukuqonda umoya (tone) kanye lenhloso yomkhulumi — uyathukuthela, uyathaba, uyaxwayisa, njll.

IZAKHONO ZOKUKHULUMA
1. Ukukhuluma ngokucacileyo lokusebenzisa ilizwi elizwakalayo.
2. Ukusebenzisa uhlelo lolimi olulungileyo lapho ukhuluma — ukuvumelana kwezitho zenkulumo lakukhulunywayo, hatshi kuphela ekubhaleni.
3. Ukwazi ukuxoxa ngesihloko esithile ngokuhlelekileyo — isingeniso, umzimba, kanye lesiphetho, ngitsho lekukhulumeni.
4. Ukuhlonipha lokulalela abanye lapho bekhuluma, ungabaphazamisi.

IMIGOMO YENHLONIPHO EKUKHULUMENI (RESPECTFUL SPEECH)
Kusiko lakoNdebele ukuthi abancane bahloniphe abadala ekukhulumeni ngokusebenzisa amazwi enhlonipho, njengokungabizi abadala ngamabizo abo qobo kodwa ngokuthi "baba", "mama", "khulu", "sisi", "mkhulu". Kanjalo, ukukhuluma lomuntu omdala kumele kugcinwe umoya wokuzithoba, ungadidizeli, njalo ulalele lokho abakutshoyo ungabaphazamisi phakathi.

IZINHLOBO ZOKUKHULUMA EZIFUNDISWAYO
(a) Ukubingelelana (greetings) — "Salibonani," "Livukile kuhle na?" "Sisaphila, kunjani kwelakini?"
(b) Ukwethula umuntu (introductions) — "Lo ngu-Nkosana, ungumngane wami." "Ngingubani..."
(c) Ukucela lokwenza isikhalazo (requests/complaints) — "Ngingacela ukuthi..." "Kulesikhalazo esithile engifisa ukusiveza..."
(d) Ukwethula ingxoxo (debate/discussion) — ukubeka umbono kanye lokuphikisana ngenhlonipho: "Ngiyavuma lawe kodwa..." "Umbono wami uhlukile ngoba..."

INDLELA YOKWENZA UMSEBENZI WOKUKHULUMA KUKILASI
Othisha bahlela imisebenzi enjengokuxoxa ngesihloko esithile phambi kwekilasi, ukwenza inkulumo emfitshane (short speech), kumbe ukudlala imidlalo yokulingisela (role play) ukuze abafundi baqeqetshe ukukhuluma isiNdebele ngokukhululeka lokuzethemba.

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Hlela abafundi babe ngamaqembu amabili amabili, kube lomunye okhulumayo lomunye olalelayo. Okhulumayo uxoxa ngomcimbi owenzakale ekhaya kumbe emphakathini, kuthi olalelayo abhale amaphuzu amathathu amakhulu awazwileyo, njalo baphindaselane izikhundla.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes

subject: IsiNdebele
content:
AMASIKO LEZINTO ZESINTU — IBANGA 7

ISINGENISO
IsiNdebele kasiyisikhona nje ulimi, kodwa siphathelene ngokuqinileyo lamasiko esintu amaNdebele. Ibanga 7 lifundiswa ukwazi amasiko amakhulu, ukuwahlonipha, kanye lokuwachaza ngolimi olufaneleyo, njengoba lokhu kuqakathekile ekugcineni umlando kanye lesiko lohlanga.

1. IZITHAKAZELO (CLAN PRAISES)
Izithakazelo ngamazwi enhlonipho asetshenziswa ukubonga umuntu ngokwesibongo (surname/clan name) sakhe, atshengise ukuthi ungowaphi umuzi. Isibonelo: uMoyo ubizwa ngokuthi "Dabengwa, Mkhize, weNdlovu ka..." Izithakazelo zisetshenziswa ekukhulumeni okusemthethweni, emicimbini yomndeni, kanye lasekuhlonipheni abadala.

2. IMICIMBI YOKUZALWA KANYE LOKWETHIWA IBIZO (BIRTH AND NAMING CEREMONIES)
Nxa umntwana ezelwe, umndeni uba lomcimbi wokumamukela emhlabeni. Ibizo lomntwana lihlala liqondene lezimo ezenzakele ngesikhathi umntwana ezelwa, isibonelo umntwana angathiwa "Nkosana" nxa kulomuntu obalulekileyo owafikayo mhlaka lowo, kumbe "Nomathemba" nxa umndeni ubulindele ithemba.

3. IMICIMBI YOMTSHADO (MARRIAGE CUSTOMS)
Umtshado wesintu emaNdebeleni ubandakanya izigaba ezinengi:
(a) Ukukhangwa/Ukuqoma — indoda ikhangayo intombi.
(b) Ukulotsholwa (lobola/bride wealth negotiations) — abakwababa bendoda bayahamba komakoti ukuyaxoxisana ngenkomo/imali yelobolo lezinye izipho.
(c) Umgcagco — umcimbi omkhulu lapho umtshado usenziwa khona ngokusemthethweni phambi kwemindeni yomibili.
Amasiko la asiza ukuqinisa ubuhlobo phakathi kwemindeni emibili, hatshi ukuthengiswa komuntu njengoba abanye bengaqonda kubi.

4. UKUHLONIPHA ABADALA (RESPECT FOR ELDERS)
Emphakathini wamaNdebele, inhlonipho kubadala ingumgogodla wempilo. Umntwana kumele: angabizi abadala ngamabizo abo qobo, alalele nxa kukhulunywa, angabambi izinto ngesandla sokhohlo lapho enika umdala, aguqe kancinyane lapho ehlangana lomuntu omdala njengophawu lokuhlonipha.

5. IZILWANE ZOMNDENI (TOTEMS - ISIBONGO/ISIDUZI)
Umndeni ngamunye emaNdebeleni ulesilwane esikhethekileyo esimela usendo lwabo (totem), esingadliwa ngabomndeni lowo ngenxa yokuthi silomlando lohlonzi lwabo. Lokhu kusiza ekwazini ukuthi umuntu ungowaphi umndeni, njalo kuvimbela ukuganana phakathi kwabomndeni owodwa.

6. IMICIMBI YOKUFA LOKUNGCWABA (FUNERAL CUSTOMS)
Nxa kufa umuntu, umphakathi uyahlangana ukusiza umndeni osizini, kwenziwe imicimbi yokulinda isidumbu (ukulinda), ukungcwaba, kanye leyokukhumula isililo (unveiling of tombstone) ngemva kwesikhathi esithile.

7. IZINGOMA LEMIDANSO YESINTU (TRADITIONAL SONGS AND DANCES)
AmaNdebele ehlukanisa imidanso ngokwemicimbi ehlukeneyo — imidanso yentokozo, eyemfundiso, kanye leyokukhulekela. Le midanso ihlanganisa ukubethwa kwezigubhu, ukucula, kanye lokugida okuhlanganisa umphakathi wonke.

UKUQAKATHEKA KOKUFUNDA NGAMASIKO
Ukwazi ngamasiko kusiza abafundi ukuthi bazazi ngokwabo, bahloniphe usendo lwabo, njalo bakwazi ukuhlanganisa impilo yesimanje lamasiko endabuko ngendlela efaneleyo.

UMSEBENZI WOKUZIHLOLA
Cela abafundi ukuthi baxoxe labazali kumbe abadala emakhaya abo ngesiko elilodwa elingaqondananga lomndeni wabo, babhale isifinyezo esimfitshane sesikufundileyo, basiveze phambi kwekilasi.
source: ZIMSEC Junior (Grade 3-7) IsiNdebele Syllabus — compiled Grade 7 study notes
